response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.zoneref, st.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON st.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag >= '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag <= '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_of_avg_size_per_min FROM g

assumptions.assumption: The date range is inclusive at both ends (BETWEEN semantics) and compared as text against chronotag.
Linked to a site means an inner join of scans.zoneref to sites.zoneregistry.

A spanmin of 0 is treated as missing (NULLIF) to avoid division by zero; NULL gbsize, spanmin or pressratio values are ignored by AVG. Groups where every value is NULL give a NULL average, which the outer AVG skips.
